name: Anantam Highways Trust
summary: Anantam Highways Trust, an infrastructure investment trust, owns, operates, manages, and invests in road infrastructure assets in India. Its portfolio of road infrastructure assets include the national highways having total aggregate length of 273.25 kilometres located in the states of Karnataka, Telangana, Gujarat, Bihar, and Tamil Nadu, India. The company was founded in 2024 and is based in Mumbai, India.
